title: Smallest Inexpressible Bitwise OR
description:
Given an array of integers 'nums', you can form various values by calculating the bitwise OR of any non-empty subsequence. An integer x is said to be 'expressible' if there exists at least one subsequence whose elements, when OR-ed together, equal x.

Your task is to identify the smallest positive integer (greater than 0) that is NOT expressible using any subsequence from the given array.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n, the number of elements in the array.
The second line contains n space-separated integers representing the array 'nums'.
output_format: Print the smallest positive integer that cannot be formed as a bitwise OR of any subsequence.
